about: Shared contract for the usage snapshot. The same bytes live in agent-team-template and agent-cockpit; a test in each repo checks they match.
rules: usedPercent appears only inside a limits block whose status is found
a missing source is { status: not found }, never a zero
a window whose resetsAt has passed shows no percentage
resetsAt may be missing or null; the board then says the reset time is unknown
the freshness shown is the reading time (limits.readAt), not only the file time (takenAt)
